title: Two Brothers Execute Random Guy in Hit-Style Murder
description:
Kalamazoo police respond to a fatal shooting at an apartment complex where 30-year-old Charles Lee is found dead in a stairwell. Investigators link the crime to brothers DonQuay White and Deyonte Armstrong, eventually tracking both down and confronting them with surveillance footage.
